cross_contract_adversarial_checks.invariant: App/Core separation and strict request types
cross_contract_adversarial_checks.assessment: Rust denies unknown request/argument fields and rejects unsupported operation/schema/output/ID/audio types. App helper accepts only stdin, validates managed runtime before app peer exchange, and does not add endpoint overrides or prompt/audio argv. Actual compiled Rust state reply parses in Dart; Core framing is unchanged. Dart result payloads remain operation-specific dynamic maps, not a generated shared schema; validated Rust producer, identity/correlation checks and tests establish the bounded current contract, not universal hostile-payload validation.

cross_contract_adversarial_checks.invariant: Single admission, persisted acknowledgement, dedup and no queue
cross_contract_adversarial_checks.assessment: Commit occurs under mutex before dispatch/acknowledgement; identical ID/fingerprint returns existing status, changed input returns ID_CONFLICT, active work blocks new work/config. Unsafe publication prevents inference. Provider work is outside socket handler. Commit failure is fail-closed, not an inference retry.

cross_contract_adversarial_checks.invariant: F1 worker ownership and F2/F3 corruption preservation
cross_contract_adversarial_checks.assessment: Final external handle revokes publication ownership under commit mutex and waits boundedly; old gated worker cannot overwrite reopened state or begin follow-on synthesis after the tested revocation point. Multiple running records are rejected before interruption reconciliation; nested inventories/results/errors/types/size bounds are validated and corrupt bytes preserved. Already-started external inference is not forcibly cancelled; filesystem sync is not a deadline guarantee.

cross_contract_adversarial_checks.invariant: Durable bounded history, restart, expiry and CAPACITY
cross_contract_adversarial_checks.assessment: History remains complete pairs <=16 and total UTF-8 content <=65536 bytes. Jobs <=32, expired-ID tombstones <=1024; exhaustion explicitly returns CAPACITY while known IDs still deduplicate and expired IDs cannot resurrect. Restart preserves preferences/terminal text and marks unfinished work interrupted without replay. Audio is stripped from disk. This is bounded context and operation metadata, not archival chat or unlimited operation capacity; explicit state maintenance is required at exhaustion.

cross_contract_adversarial_checks.invariant: All four paths, mixed drafts, stale replies and no auto-send/resend/playback
cross_contract_adversarial_checks.assessment: Unchanged typed draft gets newline-appended dictation; capture-start draft revision protects edits during recording/transcription and exposes explicit insertion. Recording/transcription never submits a model turn. Only explicit Send admits submission. Uncertain acknowledgements remain query-only; timeout does not mean cancellation. Reattach disables playback and does not resend. Speech-off revokes playback without cancelling capture; re-enabling cannot replay old audio. Expired local forget requires correlation and UI confirmation; it preserves draft/history and discloses unknown outcome/duplicate risk.

cross_contract_adversarial_checks.invariant: Speech failure must preserve useful text and typed input
cross_contract_adversarial_checks.assessment: Unavailable speech does not fail usable LLM inventory. Generated text survives failed/oversized TTS without regeneration or silent truncation. Missing microphone utility is visible and leaves typed Send usable; playback failure retains answer. Private transient audio and fixed captured native child cleanup are exercised without a microphone.

cross_contract_adversarial_checks.invariant: Local provider identities, audio bytes and packaging do not broaden authority
cross_contract_adversarial_checks.assessment: Numeric loopback destinations, no proxy/redirect/retry/cloud substitution, exact eligible installed tag and tool-free response checks are implemented. STT accepts raw mono16k PCM16 WAV; TTS strict JSON yields mono24k WAV bytes; paths are not API inputs. Sidecar allows transcript <=64 KiB but Rust deliberately rejects >16 KiB for app draft; safe rejection, not silent truncation. Compose has two internal networks, loopback ports, narrow read-only existing model mounts, nonroot/read-only rootfs, dropped capabilities and bounded resources. Dagger tests override image CMD with pip/unittest; no provider server, model mounts or publications. These source properties do not prove deployed firewall/egress, real weights or host audio behavior.

cross_contract_adversarial_checks.invariant: Docs retain installed-service mismatch and approval gates
cross_contract_adversarial_checks.assessment: Current source statements distinguish fake/build evidence from live behavior and publish durable retention limits/CAPACITY in architecture. Differing installed helper remains rejected. No implicit upgrade is added; exact-unit stop, backup/preserve binary and state, reviewed replacement, matching client and explicit start/validation remain separately approved deployment steps. Historical target/debug paragraphs are qualified/superseded by current voice sections, not deployment guarantees.
